name: bfa-global-plugins
description: BFA Global's public Claude plugins, for BFA contractors who use their own Claude plan.

plugins.name: cloud-brain-bfa
plugins.description: The BFA wiki (BFA Brain): search what it knows and add meetings, mail, documents and conversations to it.

plugins.name: meeting-prep
plugins.description: Prepares you for one meeting on your calendar, from your own Calendar, Gmail, Drive and meeting notes.

plugins.name: meeting-followup
plugins.description: Turns a meeting that just happened into its follow-up: agreed actions with owners and dates, and a draft for you to send.
